mission.title: A Special Case
mission.description: See a Bluepill informant safely home from work.

npc.say: Did you see that new reality television show last night?
Excuse me. I have to get back to work...
I'm sorry. I'm rather busy right now.
Sharmaine is supposed to be home. Is she with you?

phase.briefing: There is a Bluepill named Sharmaine Tarn who has been in contact with Morpheus on several occasions. In exchange for information on Morpheus, we have agreed to protect her from other operatives who want her silenced. It would seem that she needs protection from us right now. See to it that she makes it home from work safely. If you botch this job I don't foresee an enjoyable employment for you.

enter.say: This is where Sharmaine Tarn works. Locate her and then escort her back to her apartment. I'll send you the address once you have her out of the area.

talk.say: Are you here for the Merovingian? Good. I'm ready to go home but I need someone to watch my back. Some strange folks have been causing me trouble and I'm worried about going home all by my lonesome... This is where you come in.

objective.text: Lead Sharmaine Tarn out of the area
Do not let Sharmaine Tarn die

phase.briefing: I'm giving you the location of Sharmaine Tarn's apartment.

enter.say: This is where Sharmaine lives. Once she is safely inside her apartment, recover the information on Morpheus from her.

objective.text: Lead Sharmaine Tarn to her apartment

done.say: Sharmaine! It's good to see that you made it home safely.

talk.say: Did you come here with Sharmaine? Well, since you're just a friend of hers, she won't mind if you sit down on the bed with me... Come on over here, cutie!
I've locked the door! You can't leave until I've had some fun with you!

done.say: What the hell was her problem?!
I can't believe she actually locked the door and tried to get it on with you... This is insane.

objective.text: Get the information from Sharmaine Tarn

talk.say: Now that I'm safe, I'll give you the information that we agreed upon... You may take it from me.

done.say: Excellent! Let's get this uploaded through a hardline so I can send it to Flood.

objective.text: Upload the information at a hardline
Do not let Sharmaine Tarn die

mission.finish: Things are going well enough for you, aren't they?
